comment: Trillion's referral rules (decision source:cmVmZXJyYWwtMjUtZWFjaC11bmxpbWl0ZWQtMjAyNi0xMC0wMg, 2026-10-02: $25 off for each side and no limit, replacing the free month of source:Z3Jvd3RoLXJlZmVycmFscy0yMDI2LTA5LTI5). Read by src/shares.mjs (who joined through whose link and what each earned), src/payment.mjs (the rewards) and the Account screen. `friend` is what someone who joined through a link gets: the checkout-code-adjustment row `code_id`, whose `adjustment` is also what the person and their AI are told the friend gets, (in records/checkout-code-adjustment-records.json) is prefilled on their checkout links for `offer_ids` while `window_days` have not passed since they joined. `referrer` is what the person whose link it was gets once that friend's first payment above zero on one of `paid_offer_ids` arrives: one arm of `credit_arms` (a test like a price test: each referrer lands on one arm, the same one every time, by `weight`; adding an amount to try is one row here), as credit Stripe takes off their next bills on the plan they pay for among `offer_ids`, with no limit unless `max_per_year` is set (at most that many in any 365 days); while they pay for none of those plans the credit waits and is given when they start one. `join_cookie` names the cookie a link visit is remembered in (the landing at gettrillion.ai sets it for the whole domain, the app for itself) and `join_cookie_days` how long, until the account is made. `credit_tool` is the operator account's Workshop tool that gives the credit on Stripe. `links` are the addresses a person's link can take, `{code}` filled in; the first is the one shown. Changing a reward, limit, window or address is a change here only. `source_cookie` names the cookie a visit's `from` value (the post or page that brought the visitor, e.g. gettrillion.ai/start?from=<post id>) is remembered in, for `source_cookie_days`; account creation records it as came-from:<new person> next to the referral credit, so a sign-up can be traced back to the post that brought it.

referrer.optimizing_for: Paying friends brought per referrer, against the credit given.
